subject: Exec intro / sponsor demo scheduling - Brightwell Health
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Cruz <dana.cruz@brightwellhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exec intro / sponsor demo scheduling - Brightwell Health

Hi Dana,

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday — enjoyed learning about Brightwell's plans for standardizing inference across care apps. We'd like to schedule a 30-45 minute exec-level demo to introduce Redwood to your sponsors (VP/CTO/CIO) and align on success metrics. Typical focus: throughput/latency economics, security/compliance posture, and rollout/ops.

Proposed windows next week (all PT):
- Tue 2026-03-10, 10:00–10:45
- Wed 2026-03-11, 14:00–14:45
- Thu 2026-03-12, 09:00–09:45

Marissa (cc) will coordinate invites and can tailor the agenda. Attached is a short exec agenda + one-pager. If those times don't work, please suggest 2-3 windows that do. Ideally Ben (CTO) and Alicia (CIO) can join for the first 20–30 minutes.

Thanks,
Jonas

Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0112

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the note and the agenda. Ben is the CTO and Alicia is our CIO; I've cc'ed Alicia.

Quick heads up: Ben is traveling on Tue morning and will be out of office Wed afternoon for a board prep meeting. Thu morning looks promising, but our team would prefer Thu 2026-03-12 at 09:00 PT or Fri 2026-03-13 late-morning PT.

Also could you include a 1-slide security summary and a short list of customer references (healthcare preferred)? That will help Alicia.

Thanks,
Dana Cruz
VP, Product Operations | Brightwell Health
dana.cruz@brightwellhealth.com
Office: (617) 555-0940

Dana — thanks for the quick reply and for looping Alicia. Thu 2026-03-12 at 09:00 PT works on our side. I've penciled it in tentatively while Marissa sends the official invite.

Per your ask, attaching a 1-slide security summary and three healthcare references; Marissa will include a short customer reference list in the invite and surface the security slide up front. If Fri 2026-03-13 ends up being prefered by Ben, we can do 11:00–11:45 PT on Friday as a backup.

Marissa: can you send the calendar invite to confirm Thu 09:00 PT and include the attachments below?

Appreciate it — looking forward to introducing the team.

Best,
